verdict.rationale: Statsig has a Console CRUD API, a CLI that can run in CI/CD to automate management of Feature Gates and Experiments, and an MCP server. Together these let an AI-native user script operations across many items, and Layers group multiple experiments and flags. However, nothing in the evidence documents a native bulk-edit, batch endpoint, or multi-select operation, so bulk work appears to mean looping over single-item calls. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or CLI commands, bulk actions via MCP, documented bulk-edit workflows in the console, independent or hands-on corroboration.
